items.description:
Dentalwize Sun Valley is a dental practice at the corner of Longboat Road and Ou Kaapse Weg in Sun Valley, offering general and emergency dental care through its team of dental professionals. The practice has been operating in the area since 2016, handling routine check-ups, treatments and other general dentistry needs for patients from Sun Valley and the surrounding Deep South.

Beyond its regular weekday and Saturday hours, the practice has arranged dedicated emergency contact by WhatsApp or call-out for Fridays, Saturdays, Sundays and public holidays, so patients with urgent dental problems are not left without care outside normal trading times. It suits patients looking for a local dentist for both scheduled appointments and after-hours emergencies.

Desray is a South African fashion retailer with a branch in Chelsea Courtyard, trading from 7 Wolfe Street in Chelsea Village, Wynberg. The store is one of several Desray boutiques around the country, with sister branches in Stellenbosch and Franschhoek among others, each selling the brand's own ladies' clothing ranges, from everyday basics and denim to dresses, knitwear and outerwear.

The Chelsea Village branch is open Monday to Friday from 9am to 5pm, Saturdays until 1:30pm, and closed on Sundays, with different hours on public holidays. It suits women in Wynberg and the surrounding southern suburbs looking for a local Desray boutique to browse the brand's current clothing ranges in person.

Dis-Chem Zevenwacht Mall Pharmacy trades as Dis-Chem Pharmacy Zevenwacht Mall, Shop 44 in the Zevenwacht Village Centre on the corner of Van Riebeeck and Polkadraai Roads in Kuils River. As part of the national Dis-Chem pharmacy and health retail chain, the branch runs a full dispensary alongside an in-store clinic, with click-and-collect available for online orders.

The pharmacy trades seven days a week, with longer hours on weekdays and Saturdays and shorter Sunday trading, while the attached clinic keeps its own weekday and weekend schedule for screenings and other clinic services. It suits shoppers and residents around Zevenwacht Mall who need prescription medicines, health products or baby and beauty items close to home.

items.description:
Fish on the Rocks is a fish-and-chips and seafood restaurant at the far end of Harbour Road in Hout Bay Harbour, serving hake, snoek, yellowtail, calamari and prawns alongside grilled seafood options from a halaal kitchen. Customer reviews describe generous portions and fresh, tasty seafood, with plenty of seating and ocean views from the restaurant.

The business says it has operated from the harbour for decades, with secure parking and space for larger groups, and trades 365 days a year. It suits locals, families and visitors to Hout Bay looking for a casual seafood meal with harbour views, whether grabbing a quick portion of fish and chips or settling in for a longer meal with a group.

Giovanni's Deliworld is a Cape Town delicatessen in Green Point, serving Italian deli produce, coffee, fine wine and grocery items. It opened on 1 June 1989 as a small deli offering fresh meals, local breads, cheeses and charcuterie, and later added a coffee bar that brought a European feel to the space.

The business is known for its sandwiches, ready-made meals and cappuccinos, and it also offers catering. Its own site describes it as the destination for Italian deli, coffee, fine wine and grocery shopping in the heart of Green Point. It suits anyone looking for ready-to-eat meals, Italian groceries or a good coffee on Main Road.

items.description:
Heideveld Community Day Centre is a City of Cape Town primary health care facility on Heideveld Road in Heideveld, within the Athlone health sub-district. The centre offers basic antenatal care, child health services, family planning, general HIV care, STI assessment and treatment, antiretroviral services and HIV testing to people living in the surrounding community.

The facility keeps weekday hours from Monday to Friday, in line with other City-run day centres in the area. It suits residents of Heideveld who need everyday primary health care close to home, from pregnancy checks and child health visits through to HIV testing and ongoing treatment.

Hello Indigo Halo is a crystal and gift shop at The Old Biscuit Mill in Woodstock, Cape Town. It describes itself as a unique space filled with fantasy, crystals, jewellery and distinctive gifts. The shop stocks raw and polished crystals, incense, statues, tarot cards and other esoteric supplies.

The store is designed for sensory exploration, with a curated mix of crystals and small finds for quiet moments and browsing. An online store with worldwide delivery extends the range beyond the shop floor. It suits visitors to the Old Biscuit Mill who are looking for crystals, gifts and something a little different.

H&M is a global fashion retailer offering affordable, trend-driven clothing and accessories for women, men, teenagers and children, with a branch at Shop KWH5 on the ground floor of Victoria Wharf Shopping Centre at the V&A Waterfront. The store carries the brand's full range, from everyday basics and denim to its H&M Home, Move activewear and childrenswear lines.

The Waterfront branch is open daily from 09:00 to 21:00, matching the extended hours of the surrounding shopping centre. It suits shoppers at the Waterfront looking for current, budget-friendly fashion for the whole family, whether picking up a few basics or putting together a full wardrobe.

JAM Clothing is a family clothing store at Golden Acre Shopping Centre in Cape Town's CBD, with ladies, mens, girls and boys ranges. The brand positions itself as famous for less, with budget-friendly kids' fashion across a range of brands and in-store promotions.

The store's own page lists the Golden Acre shop and its opening hours, and it gives the store's direct contact line for enquiries. The JAM group also runs a JAM Cares programme, which it promotes on its website. The store suits parents and families who want affordable everyday clothing close to the city centre. The shop is at Shop S25 in Golden Acre, between Strand Street and Adderley Street.

Jason Bakery is a bakery in Green Point producing fresh croissants, pastries, Danish items, brownies and brioche doughnuts, alongside other savoury baked goods, from its premises at 83 Main Road. The bakery says everything is made fresh daily, without added preservatives or enzymes, and sold for collection and takeaway rather than sit-down dining.

The Green Point bakery trades Tuesday to Saturday from 07:00 to 15:00, and on Sundays and public holidays from 08:00 to 14:00, closed on Mondays. It suits early risers and regulars in Green Point looking to grab fresh pastries, bread or a quick breakfast bite on the way past.

Jawitz Properties Pinelands is a branch of the Jawitz estate agency at Central Square in Pinelands, Cape Town. The branch has operated in Pinelands, Thornton and Maitland for about 12 years, and its profile lists residential sales, estates and new developments alongside rentals.

The branch says it listens closely to clients to understand their property needs, and it stresses professional service and ethical standards. Its profile features area guides, bond calculators and the latest listings to rent. It suits buyers, sellers and tenants in Pinelands and the surrounding area. The branch is at Shop 6, Central Buildings in Central Square, so buyers and tenants can visit in person.

items.description:
Kelfords Ford & Mazda is an independent Ford franchise dealership at 11 Victoria Street in Somerset West, selling new and used vehicles. Its Ford-accredited service centre and parts department handle servicing and repairs, using genuine Ford parts and expert technicians. The dealership also sells tyres from top brands and accessories such as roll bars, tow bars and load-box covers.

Customers can book a Ford service online by filling in a booking sheet, and the dealership confirms each booking by email, SMS or phone. Its fitment and detailing centre fits Llumar window film that reduces UV and heat and helps guard against smash-and-grab attacks. Full valets, nano protection and paint protection are also offered. The dealership suits Ford owners in Somerset West who want service, parts and vehicle protection in one place.

items.description:
Lentegeur Clinic is a City of Cape Town primary health care facility at the corner of Merrydale and Melkbos Roads in Lentegeur, Mitchells Plain. Alongside everyday consultations, the clinic handles basic antenatal checks, child health visits, family planning, HIV care, STI screening and treatment, antiretroviral treatment and HIV testing for people living in the surrounding area.

The clinic is open on weekdays from 08:00 to 16:30. Families in Lentegeur and the wider Mitchells Plain community can use it for routine primary health care, from pregnancy and child health visits through to ongoing HIV treatment and testing, without needing to travel further afield.

Louis Vuitton's Cape Town boutique trades from Shop 6256 and 6259B on the Upper Level of Victoria Wharf Shopping Centre at the V&A Waterfront, offering men's and women's leather goods, shoes and accessories including eyewear, belts, ties and fine jewellery, alongside travel and luggage, gifting, perfume and hard-sided trunks. The boutique positions itself as a curated Louis Vuitton experience for clients discovering the city, built around the house's timeless icons.

Beyond browsing and buying, the store offers personal appointments with client advisors, hot stamping, aftercare and repairs, and fragrance refills. It is open daily from 09:00 to 21:00, and suits visitors and shoppers at the Waterfront looking for luxury fashion, travel pieces or a considered gift, with the option to book a one-on-one appointment in advance.

Mantra Cafe is a cafe by the sea in Camps Bay, Cape Town, upstairs at 43 Victoria Road. It has been open since 2016 and describes itself as a grand cafe by the sea. The cafe serves walk-in breakfast, and lunch and dinner from an a la carte menu, with a room that looks out across the Atlantic.

The cafe also hosts art exhibitions, and it currently shows a series of new and recent works by a local artist. Guests can book a table through its website. It suits a relaxed breakfast or a sea-view meal in Camps Bay. The room is upstairs, so the view across the bay is part of the experience of eating there.

items.description:
Morning Star Foods is a factory shop in Maitland Park selling honey, spreads, healthy snacks and other pantry ingredients directly to the public at factory-shop prices. The business has traded since 1993, and its range of wholesome foods changes regularly as new stock comes through, so regulars often find something different worth picking up on each visit.

Buying directly from the factory shop rather than through a supermarket keeps prices down on everyday pantry items, snacks and spreads that would otherwise carry a standard retail mark-up. The shop trades from Unit 20B1, Maitland Park, on Voortrekker Road, keeping weekday hours from 8am to 4pm. It suits shoppers across Maitland and Bellville looking for competitively priced snacks, honey and pantry staples, including anyone specifically after factory-shop pricing on everyday ingredients.

MTN's Golden Acre branch is a mobile phone and connectivity store at Shop 61A in the Golden Acre Shopping Centre on Adderley Street, in Cape Town's CBD. The store sells mobile phones, SIM cards, prepaid and postpaid plans, data bundles and fibre internet, along with business connectivity solutions for companies that need more than a single mobile line.

Customers can shop in person, arrange pickup or delivery, or bring a device in for repair-related services, making it a practical stop for both everyday upgrades and account queries. It suits individual customers, families and small businesses in and around the CBD looking for MTN products, airtime and data, or help with an existing account.

items.description:
New Balance Outlet is a New Balance factory outlet store in Access Park, at Shop A16, 1 Van Riebeeck Road in Kuils River. The store is confirmed by the Access Park centre itself as a New Balance Outlet Store, selling the brand's running shoes, casual sneakers and activewear for men, women and children at outlet pricing.

Shoppers can expect the same New Balance ranges found in full-price stores, from performance running shoes to everyday casual footwear, at reduced prices as part of the broader Access Park outlet offering. It suits athletes, active families and anyone in the Kuils River and Bellville area looking for discounted New Balance footwear and apparel without travelling further for it.

Noluthando Educare Centre is an early childhood day care centre founded in 2010. It began as a small group of passionate educators and has grown into a community hub. The centre's approach is play-based learning, which it says has shaped how children are nurtured as it has evolved.

The centre describes its environment as nurturing and inclusive, with values designed to help every child feel valued and supported in their learning. It celebrates diversity and engages families and the wider community, which it sees as essential to children's development. It suits parents in Imizamo Yethu who want an early learning centre that puts play and inclusion first.

items.description:
Old Khaki is a casual lifestyle clothing store at the V&A Waterfront, on the Upper Level of Victoria Wharf Shopping Centre. It sells relaxed clothing and accessories for men and women, from everyday essentials to durable outdoor pieces, in a casual South African style.

The Waterfront's store listing shows a rating of 4.4 from 25 Google reviews and gives the store's contact details. The brand's clothing is designed for people who value relaxed, easygoing living. It suits shoppers who want casual wardrobe staples, and visitors exploring the Waterfront who want to pick up something practical. The store is on the Upper Level of Victoria Wharf, in Shops 7245 and 7246.

items.description:
Paradise Road is a bakery cafe inside Cardiff Castle at 58 Main Street in Newlands, Cape Town. Its counter offers fresh patisserie, croissants and French pastries, with daily salads and sandwiches available in store. The cafe also bakes fresh bread and serves coffee, with breakfast and light lunches on the menu.

The business sells a pantry range online for collection in store, so customers can order ahead and pick up from the cafe. Cardiff Castle, where the cafe sits, is the historic heart of Newlands Village and is home to restaurants and artisanal delis. Paradise Road suits a morning coffee, a breakfast or a light lunch in Newlands.

items.description:
Petrie's Pharmacy is a family pharmacy at 13 Regent Road in Sea Point, Cape Town, founded in the early 1940s. The practice was taken over in 1992 together with long-standing staff, and it describes its service as friendly, caring and helpful in a retail pharmacy setting.

The pharmacy dispenses prescriptions and offers chronic medication management and personalised health advice. It also runs a delivery service, offers complimentary medicine and holds free health screenings, including blood pressure checks. It suits residents of Sea Point who want a community pharmacy close to home. Its listing and site both give the Regent Road address, and customers can contact the pharmacy by phone or through its contact form for questions about prescriptions and health advice.

Pho & Bun Vietnamese Kitchen is a halaal Vietnamese restaurant in Diep River, Cape Town, and is Muslim-owned. The menu covers Asian Vietnamese dishes, with light meals, lunch and dinner service, takeaways and delivery.

Guests can use the car park, pay by credit card and rely on waiter service, and the restaurant is wheelchair accessible. Its listing gives a medium price range of about R100 to R300 per person, which makes it a casual option for families and groups. It suits diners who want Vietnamese food prepared to halaal standards in the Diep River area. Guests can eat in or take their meal home, and the restaurant also takes orders for delivery.

items.description:
Platinum Hospitality Holdings is a hotel asset management company that manages hotels on behalf of their owners, working to protect their investment, maximise long-term returns and keep each property compliant with its brand standards. Its services cover operational efficiency, risk mitigation and ongoing performance monitoring across the hotels in its portfolio, giving owners expert oversight without having to run day-to-day asset management themselves.

The company's office is at Suite 606 on the 6th floor of The Point in Sea Point, where its hotel asset management team is based. It suits hotel owners and investors who want specialist hospitality expertise managing their asset, rather than handling brand compliance and performance monitoring in-house.

PNA Meadowridge is a stationery, arts and crafts store at Shop 29 in the Meadowridge Shopping Centre on Howard Drive, part of the national PNA retail chain. PNA describes itself as a market leader in its sector, with a network of more than 70 independent, owner-managed stores trading under the PNA brand since 1992, each stocking a comprehensive range of stationery, art and craft products.

The Meadowridge store is listed on PNA's own store locator, with weekday and Saturday hours from 08:00 to 18:00 and Sunday hours from 08:00 to 15:00. It suits parents, students, crafters and office customers in Meadowridge looking for stationery, art supplies or craft materials without a trip to a bigger shopping centre.

PNA is a stationery, art and craft retailer inside Plattekloof Village Shopping Centre on Plattekloof Road, listed under stationery, art supply, book, craft and office supply categories. Customer reviews describe helpful, knowledgeable staff and a well-organised shop, with one longtime customer calling it consistently tidy and well stocked on repeat visits.

The Plattekloof branch keeps longer weekday hours than many neighbourhood stores, open from 09:00 to 19:00 Monday to Friday, 09:00 to 18:00 on Saturdays and 09:00 to 17:00 on Sundays. It suits shoppers in Plattekloof looking for scholastic and office stationery, art and craft materials, or a gift, without driving to one of the larger nearby malls.

items.description:
Restore Dental Studio is a dental practice at Shop 11 in the Panorama Healthcare Centre on Hennie Winterbach Street, Panorama, offering general oral healthcare from examinations and professional scale-and-polish treatments to gum treatment and full treatment planning. Beyond routine check-ups, the practice also handles fillings, extractions, crowns, bridges and teeth whitening for patients needing more involved dental work.

The practice treats patients of different ages and accepts most medical aid schemes, and also lists a second Panorama address alongside its Healthcare Centre practice. It is open on weekdays and closed over weekends, and suits families in Panorama who want a local dentist for both everyday oral care and more involved restorative treatment.

items.description:
Rondebosch Veterinary Hospital is a fully equipped small-animal veterinary hospital at 111 Campground Road in Rondebosch, using modern equipment and technology for consultations, surgical procedures and ongoing patient care. The practice says its team follows an ongoing continuing-education programme, backing its aim of providing the highest standard of medical and surgical care for every pet that comes through the door.

Alongside its veterinary services, the hospital runs a front shop for pet owners needing food, accessories and other everyday pet-care items, and keeps routine consultation hours on weekdays and Saturdays. It suits pet owners across Rondebosch and the wider Southern Suburbs of Cape Town looking for a well-resourced local practice for both routine visits and more involved veterinary care.

SA Dairy Factory Shop is a factory outlet in Boston, Bellville, supplying and manufacturing food and beverage products at factory-shop prices for both retail and wholesale buyers. The shop is listed as a supplier of Henties juices and other retail products, alongside its wider range of dairy and grocery items.

The factory shop trades from 33 Northumberland Road, open Monday to Friday from 9am to 5pm and Saturdays from 9am to 2pm, closed on Sundays and trading until 2pm on public holidays. It suits households and businesses in Boston and Bellville looking for dairy, juice and other food and beverage products at factory-shop prices rather than standard retail mark-ups.

Salsify at The Roundhouse is a fine-dining restaurant on the upper level of the historic Roundhouse building in Camps Bay, a national monument dating back to 1786. The restaurant is included on the World's 50 Best Discovery list of restaurants, and builds its menu around modern, seasonal dishes made with local ingredients, currently offered as a ten-course Chef's Menu.

Diners can also arrange a Salsify gift card for a future visit, a popular option for marking a special occasion. Set in the Roundhouse's historic dining room, the restaurant looks out over the Atlantic Ocean and Lion's Head, and suits diners after a tasting-menu style fine-dining experience with some of the best views in Camps Bay.

Schoon is a bakery and cafe on the ground floor of The Point in Sea Point, serving freshly baked bread and pastries made with local wheat, real butter and pastured eggs, alongside a seasonal breakfast and lunch menu. The Point Mall describes the cafe as collaborating with committed local artisans and farmers, bringing their produce into Schoon's baking and daily menu.

The Sea Point branch is one of several Schoon cafes around the Western Cape, each built around the same focus on seasonal, produce-driven food and daily-baked bread. It suits Sea Point locals and visitors to The Point looking for a coffee, a fresh pastry, or a sit-down breakfast or lunch made with carefully sourced ingredients.

Shakespeare's is a restaurant in Heritage Square on Vrede Street in Durbanville, Cape Town, with a theatrical theme. It is a re-imagining of a 50-year-old Durbanville establishment, and it serves breakfast, lunch, dinner and high tea. The concept is fine food, good wine and entertainment for grown-ups.

The interior uses old furnishings and crockery brought in from around the country, and the restaurant displays a 404-year-old bible and a 90-year-old baby grand piano. The menu follows the theme, with a main dish named after a quote from The Merchant of Venice and a dessert named after Hamlet. Nightly performances are part of the evening. It suits diners who want an evening out with food and theatre.

Shift Espresso Bar is a specialty coffee shop and cafe on Main Road in Green Point, opened in June 2014 with an industrial-style interior of exposed copper light fittings and metal shelving. Beyond the expected cappuccinos, lattes, flat whites and Americanos, the bar built its name on its own specialty coffee creations, alongside cafe food and all-day seating for customers who want to linger.

The cafe positions itself around coffee, food, service and the overall customer experience, with free Wi-Fi, laptop plug points and charging stations making it as practical for a work session as for a quick coffee. It suits Green Point locals and visitors looking for a relaxed, informal spot to work, meet or simply enjoy a well-made coffee.
